name: Modules.Barcode
description:
#### System Requirements

- Titanium SDK 5.5.1+
- Camera Permissions set in your tiapp.xml:

``` xml
<ti:app>
  <!-- ... -->
  <ios>
    <plist>
      <dict>
        <key>NSCameraUsageDescription</key>
        [string](api:Global.String)We need permission to access your device camera.</string>
      </dict>
    </plist>
  </ios>
  <!-- ... -->
</ti:app>
```

properties.name: allowInstructions
properties.summary: Whether or not to display helpful instructions or a changelog when the app is updated.

properties.name: allowMenu
properties.summary: Whether or not to allow the built-in ZXing menu to display.

properties.name: allowRotation
properties.summary:
Value that indicates if the barcode capture should analyze captured images in either portrait or landscape device
orientation. (Warning: Analyzing both the captured image and the rotated version(s) of the image will increase the
processing time of the capture.)

* true: Captured images will be analyzed in both portrait and landscape orientation.
* false [default]: Captured images will be analyzed using only the current device orientation.

properties.name: useFrontCamera
properties.summary:
Controls whether or not the front camera on the device will be used to capture barcodes.
On Android, this requires API level 9 (Android OS 2.3) or higher.
If no front camera is available, this will gracefully fall back to utilize whatever camera is available.

properties.name: useLED
properties.summary: Whether or not to use the LED when scanning barcodes (also known as the flashlight, torch, or some derivation thereof).

methods.name: capture

inlined.summary: Simple object passed to [Modules.Barcode.capture](api:Modules.Barcode#capture) to capture a Barcode.

properties.name: acceptedFormats
properties.summary:
An optional array of int constants detailing which barcode formats are accepted. Defaults to all formats.
Check out the "Barcode Format Constants" section below to see the available int constants.

properties.name: allowedEANExtensions
properties.summary:
An optional int[] that specifies allowed extension lengths for EAN or UPC barcodes.
https://zxing.github.io/zxing/apidocs/

properties.name: allowedLengths
properties.summary:
An optional int[] that specifies allowed lengths of encoded data -- reject anything else.
https://zxing.github.io/zxing/apidocs/

properties.name: animate
properties.summary: Indicates if the device should animate between the current activity and the camera activity when the current activity is in a different orientation than the camera. Default is true.

properties.name: assumeCode39CheckDigit
properties.summary:
An optional boolean which if true, will assume Code 39 codes employ a check digit.
https://zxing.github.io/zxing/apidocs/

Please note that this hint only applies to [CODE_39](api:Modules.Barcode#FORMAT_CODE_39) format barcodes.

properties.name: assumeGS1
properties.summary:
An optional boolean to assume the barcode is being processed as a GS1 barcode, and modify behavior as needed.
https://zxing.github.io/zxing/apidocs/

Please note that this hint only applies to [CODE_128](api:Modules.Barcode#FORMAT_CODE_128) format barcodes.

properties.name: characterSet
properties.summary:
An optional string that specifies what character encoding to use when decoding, where applicable
https://zxing.github.io/zxing/apidocs/

properties.name: frameHeight
properties.summary: Height of the rectangle that is shown in the scanner

properties.name: frameWidth
properties.summary: Width of the rectangle that is shown in the scanner

properties.name: keepOpen
properties.summary:
Whether or not to keep the barcode scanner open after a barcode is recognized. Defaults to false.
When set to true, "success" will fire once every time a barcode is recognized, up to two times per second.
As such, it can fire multiple times for a single barcode!

properties.name: overlay
properties.summary: The view to lay on top of the camera activity.

properties.name: preventRotation
properties.summary: Prevent the scanner from auto-rotating when the device is rotated. Default: true

properties.name: pureBarcode
properties.summary:
An optional boolean to assume the image is a pure monochrome image of a barcode.
https://zxing.github.io/zxing/apidocs/

properties.name: resultDuration
properties.summary: Time in milliseconds that the result will be visible after a scan.

properties.name: returnCodabarStartEnd
properties.summary:
An optional boolean which if true, will return the start and end digits in a Codabar barcode instead of stripping them.
https://zxing.github.io/zxing/apidocs/

Please note that this hint only applies to [CODABAR](api:Modules.Barcode#FORMAT_CODABAR) format barcodes.

properties.name: showCancel
properties.summary: Whether or not to include the default cancel button. Defaults to true.

properties.name: showInfoText
properties.summary: Whether to show informational text

properties.name: showRectangle
properties.summary: Whether or not to include the default rectangle around the scanning area. Defaults to true.

properties.name: tryHarder
properties.summary:
An optional boolean to spend more time to try to find a barcode; optimize for accuracy, not speed.
https://zxing.github.io/zxing/apidocs/
